name: Freepik
tagline: A creative suite with AI image, video and audio generation alongside a large stock library.
about: Freepik combines a stock library of photos, vectors and templates with AI tools for generating and editing images, video and audio.
pros: Several leading image and video models in one subscription.
Large library of stock photos, vectors and templates.
Editing tools such as upscaling and background removal.
cons: The free plan is limited and stock assets need attribution.
